title: Support ticket lifecycle, SLA, test visibility, and dedupe integrity

phases.objective: Prevent cross-parent ticket dedupe, compute milestone-aware SLA, classify test tickets explicitly, and reconcile contradictory lifecycle state.

e2e_journeys.actor: authenticated tenant member or platform admin
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Tickets use v2 structured dedupe, test records are excluded from the tenant inbox, SLA respects completed milestones, and guarded reconciliation reports or repairs inconsistencies.
steps: Authorize the tenant caller through active workspace membership.
Build a canonical SHA-256 dedupe identity from tenant, user, ticket type, capability, resource, relationship, and intended parent ticket.
Classify smoke and simulation records with is_test, environment, and visibility_class.
Create or append through the existing governed ticket lifecycle using the v2 dedupe key.
List tenant tickets by GREATEST(last_seen_at, updated_at, created_at) while excluding test records by default.
Reconcile SLA milestones and internally resolved tickets through dry-run or typed-confirmation apply mode.
assertions: Different intended parent ticket IDs produce different dedupe keys.
Different target capabilities produce different dedupe keys.
Completed first-response and triage milestones do not create false breaches.
Resolution due dates still breach while a ticket remains open.
Known smoke and simulation tickets are internal_test and absent from the tenant inbox by default.
The exact open/resolved_runtime_validated contradiction is eligible for a guarded resolved transition.
Apply mode fails closed before migration readiness and requires typed confirmation.
No migration apply, external delivery, credential access, force push, or production promotion occurs in this PR.

phases.objective: Expose dry-run findings, schema readiness, urgent unassigned counts, and typed-confirmation apply mode.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The administrator receives bounded findings in dry-run mode and apply mode remains guarded by schema readiness and typed confirmation.
steps: Authenticate the administrator and backend API key.
Read a bounded set of open tickets and calculate lifecycle, SLA, visibility, relationship, and assignment findings.
Return dry-run counts and per-ticket proposed changes without mutation.
Reject apply mode when the migration is absent or typed confirmation is missing.
Apply only tenant-scoped updates inside a transaction when all guards pass.
assertions: Apply mode fails closed when required columns are missing.
Urgent unassigned and test-ticket counts are reported explicitly.

phases.objective: Remain readable before migration, fail closed for apply mode, and preserve the legacy support routes after the integrity router.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: tenant ticket list/create routes and admin integrity reconciliation
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Tenant reads and ticket creation remain available through metadata fallbacks while all schema-dependent mutations fail closed until migration readiness.
steps: Inspect required ticket integrity columns through INFORMATION_SCHEMA.
Use metadata and title fallbacks to suppress test tickets before migration.
Preserve the legacy support router after the integrity router for unchanged detail and workflow operations.
Reject schema-dependent apply reconciliation with a typed 409 error.
Return missing-column evidence without exposing secrets.
assertions: Tenant list remains readable before migration.
Ticket creation continues through the existing governed lifecycle.
Apply reconciliation cannot partially update a pre-migration schema.
Legacy detail and workflow routes remain mounted.

phases.objective: Apply migration 1042 in an authorized non-production database and read back known regression tickets.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: governed migration apply followed by integrity dry-run and typed apply
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: The canary database exposes all required columns and known test, dedupe, lifecycle, and SLA records read back with the expected corrected state.
steps: Authorize and apply migration 1042 in a non-production environment.
Read the schema readiness view and migration ledger.
Run integrity reconciliation in dry-run mode.
Apply the bounded corrections with typed confirmation.
Verify known ticket IDs and tenant inbox exclusion.

phases.objective: Apply through governed migration authority, run dry-run then typed apply reconciliation, and verify tenant inbox exclusion and SLA readback.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Production promotion, governed migration apply, and post-deploy integrity reconciliation
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Production reports the exact deployed SHA, migration ledger entry, corrected ticket states, test-ticket exclusion, and milestone-aware SLA status.
steps: Promote the reviewed exact head through the governed Production process.
Apply migration 1042 under separate authorization.
Run dry-run reconciliation and inspect bounded findings.
Apply approved corrections with typed confirmation.
Verify exact ticket IDs, tenant inbox ordering, SLA status, and customer-safe readback.
